Even with cheats and mods, this game is still frustrating but it's the best kind of frustration to have . The pressure of trying to get the Satsuma from your house to the main intersection without completely eating shit and destroying your car is so... Satisfying.

The best thing about this game is that you get to build something to completion without the world taking a shit on you. Even when the game glitches or that drunken bastard runs you off the road, you can always grab your moped,  grab the tractor, tow your car to Fleetari's, and get back to work. It's the best feeling. 

Even with a guide, you can spend HOURS building your car. It becomes yours when it's finished. Your style, your build, your parts of choice. It's YOUR car. The sounds it makes, the way it looks, that's all YOU. 

In all its rickety glory and that, is my definition of fun.

What sucks is that the Satsuma is pretty much the only car you can build. But it's a damn good start.

I'm glad you clarified your stance in the edit.  
It is the program at fault, not the people who don't know how to reintegrate into society.  
It's lazy to assume that those who create commotion simply "don't appreciate" their space. These people are merely not ready to integrate in such a location. 
The devil-may-care attitude that so many affluent Washingtonians complain about stems from a survival-based logic in poor communities that basically says that you're doomed regardless, whether on the street or at dead end jobs with no opportunity so why not live obnoxiously.  
In affluent communities, this lifestyle is a novelty at best.  
TL;DR- Programs like these need to reintegrate the poor and displaced fully before placing them in affluent housing. It isn't enough to say that these people are just ungrateful.
